legenda: Tense alternative rock, urgent and driving, male lead vocals singing in Brazilian Portuguese, palm-muted electric guitar riff in the verses, wide distorted guitars and crash cymbals in the chorus, punchy bass, tight live drums, clean arpeggiated guitar in a half-time bridge, gritty yet melodic, modern rock production, high fidelity, professional mix
inspiracao: Um rock alternativo sobre o SecurePath CLI, o farejador em Python que acha senhas, tokens e chaves esquecidas e aponta onde estão sem nunca mostrar o segredo.
descricao: Rock alternativo e tenso sobre o SecurePath CLI, o scanner estático que encontra credenciais vazadas sem revelar os valores.
